Local actions: site plan, use permit, redevelopment.
County parcel data shows 481-07-019 at 2075 Alum Rock Ave, -020 at 2055 Alum Rock Ave, -027 at 70 Sunset and -028 at 61 Sunset; 481-07-016 returns no active parcel.
Sunbelt Rentals lists its San Jose branch #353 at 2101 Alum Rock Ave.
CBRE lists 2075 Alum Rock Ave for lease as an industrial outside storage site of about 2.5 acres with 8,500 sq ft of improvements.
